title: Disappointing & predatory
body: Upon downloading the app you’re told you have a free trial and then it’s $5.99 YEARLY - it’s actually $5.99 a WEEK. The first thing I scanned was wrong. And lastly when I tried to unsubscribe on the app, I could click every single button on the app except for that one. Predatory and gross. You shouldn’t have to jump through hoops like I did to cancel it and not be taken advantage of.

title: Scam
body: Beware, this is a three day trial, then they charge you. It’d be nice to know this before downloading and going through the set up process.

title: Disappointing
body: I saw pictures of food being scanned but the app itself only gives me barcode and ingredients label options.

title: Costs too much
body: I just want a free app.

title: No response
body: I sent several emails to the support email listed in the app and never received a response. Very frustrating to use

title: Didn’t give any information aside from product name
body: The first and only thing I scanned for my shellfish allergy and it told me it couldn’t give any information and therefore couldn’t check my restrictions. It scanned the item and even told me what it was with a picture of the item. But that’s it. I love sushi and saw a salmon sushi and from what I could see there wasn’t any shellfish but I wanted to make sure because you just never know. This app gave me no useful information. Thankfully a worker was nearby and was able to help but I paid the year subscription with excitement that this app could help me. Was very wrong. Don’t recommend.

title: DO NOT DOWNLOAD
body: I recently was tested for food allergies and I have a lot. I needed an app to help me keep track so I downloaded this one. Not only did it charge me $30, the app only has a small handful of broad allergies to set and it’s not customizeable so it was useless to me. I requested a refund and was denied because they charged it as a subscription! So not only did they take $30 from me, but they planned to do it again if I hadn’t noticed! This is def a scam! Not worth $1 much less $30!

title: Cannot trust it
body: I just bought this app since I was diagnosed with alpha gal syndrome. Plus I have gluten intolerance I decided to try it out and scan a bag of chips that are gluten free according to the package. This app told me it has gluten in it. If it is wrong on this, how can I trust it on other foods? I want my money back!!

title: Nah
body: Downloaded at this am.. scanned labels around my kitchen. Everyone was sending up gluten and other flags.. yet it was wrong every time. Deleted app. Would love to be refunded. Can’t find a way to communicate with developers but this review box.

title: Awful experience
body: Don’t waste your money, this app only uses IA to find words in the label, reason why it warns you about ingredients that are not an actual problem, for example “Cocoa butter”, it’s dairy free but the app does not recognize this kind of things. I was expecting a lot more, I just tried it and I’m begging for a reimbursement.

title: Waste of time & money
body: The idea of this app is good but there are serious flaws. When you scan a product it searches for key words- sounds good right? Wrong. Numerous products are truly dairy free but if it uses the word milk at all to even say “free of milk” or “vs milk” it will mark it as “unclean” then you’re back to rereading the whole label anyways. It marked almond milk as “unclean”.

title: Not what I expected
body: There is no point in dealing with this issue as it is a waste of time and money. Its effectiveness is not very effective.

title: Overpriced and not very smart
body: Basically I ended up paying 20 bucks for a camera lens that uses AI to read labels you scan. But if that label says “gluten free” or “made in a facility without wheat” it will just see the word wheat or gluten and then tell you the product is unsafe. I’m sure there are free apps that can scan and read labels if you want that as a feature. But for this save your money and just read the label of whatever you are trying to eat. That’s 20 bucks I’ll never get back.

title: Absolute trash
body: Doesn’t work in the slightest. Feels like ai slop. No thought or care was actually put into this product. Warning about wine in my product because it has wine vinegar. Warnings on dietary fiber because it assumes it is from a gluten source. Just plain stupidity only ai and a fool can make.

title: Disappointed
body: First 2 labels scanned said no dairy was found but to check and verify. There was dairy. So a failure of the app.

title: Works poorly
body: I’m disappointed in this app... I was excited initially as they offer a lifetime license, and I prefer that to the perpetual subscription that everybody seems to want from you these days, but using the app leaves much to be desired. It misses obvious allergens, and then will latch onto part of an ingredient (e.g. “cream” in “coconut cream”) and flag that, when it’s not actually a problem. The little gray boxes that appear onscreen when it’s identifying text also always appear in the same place (middle right of screen) regardless of where the text actually is. It really doesn’t seem to read the text at all on labels with tiny text, and the fact that it just returns a “safe to eat” when this happens is alarming to say the least.

title: Terrible App
body: Supposed to detect animal products for Alpha Gal allergy. Scanned three products that contained animal products and it scanned CLEAN! Terrible App

title: Not accurate
body: I have celiac so avoiding gluten is absolutely dire. I’ve tested the scanner on things that I know have gluten such as soy sauce. In the ingredients it says wheat and the app would not pick up the fact that it said wheat I do not recommend.

title: Dose not work
body: I pointed this at a box of pasta before I paid during my 5 free scans and it gave me a warning of gluten, however as soon as I paid, not one time in 30 things that I scanned for my pantry did it come up with gluten including boxes of semolina pasta, gluten rice and processed food. I’m brand new with this gluten-free lifestyle and this app would lead me completely down the wrong path.

title: Does not work
body: Downloaded the app for the seven day trial. Went grocery shopping this afternoon and I couldn’t get it to scan anything in the store. Sorry but cancelled and deleted. Glad others can benefit from this app.

title: Disappointed
body: No trial period so 30$ down the drain for an app that is labeling things incorrectly. Says there is wheat In things I have that are certified gluten free and other things that contain wheat it is not registering which is worse. Was hoping for something g I could use so I do t have to google every single thing at the store- but this is more crunchy fear mongering than helpful celiac app. Annoyed

title: Really Great
body: I wish that it was less expensive and more accessible because it’s a really great tool to learn more about what I’m eating and putting in my body

title: Good but not perfect
body: This app is useful for products with long ingredient lists, but it’s definitely not perfect. I’ve had it say that two different foods contain gluten, because they contained fiber. When I read the actual ingredient labels, it was flagging the phrase “not a significant source of fiber”. One of the foods was even certified gluten free. For $20, I wish that some of the kinks would be worked out.

title: Peanuts
body: I like how it tells me to stay away from things I’m allergic to and not get sick

title: Amazing
body: Great for diabetic people, my dr recommended I check it out, very satisfied

title: Recommended
body: I am amazed the ability to scan any food package.Especially the separation between wheat and gluten categories is very useful. Scanner speed is crazy.

title: This app is my safety zone!!
body: I am looking for gluten free dairy free with this app. Thanks!

title: Coolest app!
body: I didn’t expect to find gluten free food with my allergy preferences this fast… thank you!

title: PERFECT
body: I love this app so much, thank you for suggesting the vegan, dairy and gluten free option. This helped me out a lot. Now it won’t take me a long time to look for ingredients I might not be able to eat. Thank you Nosher 💗🎀🧀🐀

title: Very nice app
body: It scans really quick. Another nice thing about nosher is the number of categories they have in the app.

title: Fantastic Resource
body: Very good App. Absolutely fantastic resource. I use this app to eliminate and reduce ingredients to help me achieve my fitness goals.

title: very stylish
body: A very useful and extremely high quality application. I would recommend it to everyone.
Very helpful thanks.

title: Easy to use!
body: Super easy to use! This is an amazing app to help keep healthy in this world of processed food.

title: Simple yet Effective
body: I really like the user friendly interface of this app. It does it’s job without requiring me to expand more energy than it’s needed with a lot of the apps related to Health & Life.

title: Genius!
body: This app has helped me a lot! Live saver and very easy to use interface.

title: Great App With Great Speed
body: The animations and the whole interface is very easy to use. I love how quickly it scans items. Love how it points out the different ingredients that I used to skip over in the past. Recommend for someone who is too lazy to read the back of food products.

title: Amazing product.
body: This is brilliant it has so many good uses and features. It is one of the best in its industry. Definitely would recommend.

title: Love it, very impressive app!
body: Love this app! The scanning functionality is super quick and accurate, and the UI makes it easy and fun to use. The included user guide is very thorough and is one of the best written user guides I’ve ever seen on an app. It maintains a light and humous tone while delivering all the essential information needed to use the app and improve your health. The breadth of potentially harmful ingredients it can check for is quite extensive. I’m surprised at how fast it’s able to find them! Overall I’m very impressed, keep up the great work Nosher! Looking forward to what lies ahead!

title: Simple and functional
body: First of all this is a great app hands down. I was able to get my eating habits much cleaner by knowing what is in the ingredients of the things i consume on a daily basis. However, there is a paywall. I recommend it if you are planning on scanning through the entire pantry.

title: Lifesaver in Supermarket
body: Food package ingredient labels are really small and hard to see. So, this app detects ingredients really easily. This is very helpful for me while exploring new foods!!😊

title: Just what I needed!
body: I’m amazed how helpful this app is through out my daily life. It makes it super easy for me detect and avoid unhealthy ingredients that I’m trying to stay away from. Would recommend to everyone who values their health!!
